channels.name: The Prelinger Reel
channels.tagline: Public-domain documentary from the American century.
channels.description: Educational, industrial and civil-defence films drawn from the Prelinger Archives at the Internet Archive. Every title here is in the public domain — free to watch, download and re-cut.

channels.name: Machine Age
channels.tagline: How things got made, moved and sold.
channels.description: Industry, transport and technology on film — assembly lines, wire photos, banana boats and the road trips in between. Sourced from the Prelinger Archives.
